entities.summary: Ryan Mack Ramczyk is an American former professional football player who was an offensive tackle for his entire eight-year career with the New Orleans Saints of the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Wisconsin–Stevens Point Pointers and Wisconsin Badgers, and was selected by the Saints in the first round of the 2017 NFL draft. A native of Stevens Point, Wisconsin, Ramczyk attended four different schools before transferring to Wisconsin–Madison in 2014, where he became an All-American lineman for the Badgers in the 2016 season.
